experiment: P5b2 posterior-conditioned in-range swept-JNR deployability screen
research_question: After P5b1 established raw-I/Q JNR sufficiency under oracle composition, can a frozen P4c multi-label classifier's soft six-label posterior replace that oracle context without using nominal power, true labels or a new backbone?

parent_evidence.permitted_inference: Physical JNR information exists under oracle composition.
parent_evidence.not_permitted: P5b1 does not establish a deployable posterior-conditioned estimator or a classification/threshold improvement.

input_contract.posterior_context: six sigmoid probabilities from the frozen P4c classification branch
input_contract.oracle_context: six true active labels; upper bound only, never a candidate

comparators.name: D1_analytic_posterior
comparators.input: analytic feature bank plus frozen classifier posterior

comparators.name: D2_analytic_oracle
comparators.input: same analytic feature bank plus true six-bit composition

training.loss: masked SmoothL1 on finite active target only

decision_rule.pass: The posterior is sufficiently informative to allow one separately preregistered, bounded estimator-attachment study on new identities. It still does not authorize threshold or router changes.
decision_rule.fail: Do not build a posterior-conditioned deep expert or attach any JNR estimator. Record posterior-versus-oracle information loss and retain P4c unchanged.

stop_rules: Do not select architecture, checkpoint, calibration or threshold from P5b1 confirmation outputs.
Do not expose nominal power or true labels to D1.
Do not train or fine-tune the frozen classifier.
Do not use 35-50 dB or claim parameter OOD behavior.
Do not construct a raw-I/Q deep expert in P5b2.
Do not generate, read or reopen any test or locked test.
